description: How the TmEditorShell presents its Left/Right panels on a mobile layout: both stacked in one sheet, or switched through a tab strip inside the sheet.

members.name: Sheet
members.description: One bottom sheet whose body stacks every open panel, in Left, Right order.

members.name: Tabs
members.description: A tab strip (role="tablist") inside the sheet switches between the open panels — one panel visible at a time.
